a.disp_way_cd = 'SYS00000206' THEN ( CASE WHEN cust_gun_setng_cd = 'SYS00000192' THEN a.simp_setng_id WHEN cust_gun_setng_cd = 'SYS00000193' THEN a.user_sql_id WHEN cust_gun_setng_cd = 'SYS00000194' THEN a.file_upld_id WHEN cust_gun_setng_cd = 'SYS00000195' THEN a.frcs_mdl_id WHEN cust_gun_setng_cd = 'SYS00000196' THEN a.com_evt_id WHEN cust_gun_setng_cd = 'SYS00000197' THEN a.crm_link_id ELSE '' END ) END AS 고객군셋팅_코드 , CASE WHEN a.disp_way_cd = 'SYS00000206' THEN ( CASE WHEN cust_gun_setng_cd = 'SYS00000192' THEN ( SELECT simp_setng_nm FROM tpst.pcm_st_simp_setng ia WHERE a.simp_setng_id = ia.simp_setng_id ) WHEN cust_gun_setng_cd = 'SYS00000193' THEN ( SELECT user_sql_nm FROM tpst.pcm_st_user_sql ia WHERE a.user_sql_id = ia.user_sql_id ) WHEN cust_gun_setng_cd = 'SYS00000194' THEN ( SELECT file_upld_nm FROM tpst.pcm_st_file_upld ia WHERE a.file_upld_id = ia.file_upld_id ) WHEN cust_gun_setng_cd = 'SYS00000195' THEN ( SELECT frcs_mdl_nm FROM tpst.pcm_st_frcs_mdl ia WHERE a.frcs_mdl_id = ia.frcs_mdl_id ) WHEN cust_gun_setng_cd = 'SYS00000196' THEN ( SELECT com_evt_nm FROM tpst.pcm_st_com_evt ia WHERE a.com_evt_id = ia.com_evt_id ) WHEN cust_gun_setng_cd = 'SYS00000197' THEN ( SELECT camp_nm FROM tpst.pcm_st_crm_camp_a ia WHERE SUBSTR(a.crm_link_id, 1, 10) = ia.camp_id ) ELSE '' END ) END AS 고객군셋팅_명 , a.* FROM tpst.pcm_st_card a LEFT OUTER JOIN tpst.pcm_st_card_ptup b ON a.card_id = b.card_id AND b.del_yn = 'N' WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.del_yn = 'N' ) SELECT a.card_id AS cardId , (SELECT card_nm FROM tpst.pcm_st_card ia WHERE a.card_id = ia.card_id) AS cardName , a.inv_id AS inventoryId , b.rgst_user_id AS registerUserId , (SELECT CONCAT(ib.bsic_kor_nm, ' - ', ia.bsic_kor_nm) FROM tpst.pcm_st_bsic ia , tpst.pcm_st_bsic ib WHERE a.inv_id = ia.bsic_cd_id AND ia.up_bsic_cd_id = ib.bsic_cd_id) AS inventoryName , b.cardTypeName , b.displayWayName , b.customerGroupTypeName , a.prev_vw_cnt AS prevViewCount , a.prev_ck_cnt AS prevClickCount , a.prev_cust_cnt AS prevCustomerCount , a.prev_cust_clck_cnt AS prevClickCustomerCount , a.prev_ck_cnt / a.prev_vw_cnt * 100 AS prevClickRate , a.total_view_cnt AS totalViewCount , a.total_clck_cnt AS totalClickCount , a.total_cust_cnt AS totalCustomerCount , a.total_cust_clck_cnt AS totalClickCustomerCount , a.total_clck_cnt / a.total_view_cnt * 100 AS totalClickRate , DATE_FORMAT(b.registerDate, '%Y%m%d') AS cardRegisterDate , DATE_FORMAT(a.first_vw_date, '%Y%m%d') AS firstViewDate , DATE_FORMAT(a.last_vw_date, '%Y%m%d') AS lastViewDate FROM ( SELECT card_id , inv_id , DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d') AS 기준일자 , SUM(CASE WHEN base_dt = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') THEN view_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS prev_vw_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN base_dt = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') THEN clck_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS prev_ck_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN base_dt = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') THEN cust_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS prev_cust_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN base_dt = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') THEN cust_clck_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS prev_cust_clck_cnt , SUM(view_cnt) AS total_view_cnt , SUM(clck_cnt) AS total_clck_cnt , SUM(cust_cnt) AS total_cust_cnt , SUM(cust_clck_cnt) AS total_cust_clck_cnt , MIN(rgst_dttm) AS first_vw_date , MAX(rgst_dttm) AS last_vw_date FROM pcm_st_card_evt_stat GROUP BY card_id ) a LEFT OUTER JOIN CARD_INFO b ON a.card_id = b.card_id WHERE b.rgst_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY prevViewCount DESC
